requirements: R1: The runtime environment must start successfully, with passing health checks, functional backup script execution, and successful database migrations without missing relation errors.

slices.title: Repair runtime initialization failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fixes for this epic, I want to repair the docker compose configuration and database migrations, so that the application environment starts cleanly
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker environment is launched
When the system initializes
Then the backend health check passes
Given the backup container starts
When the entrypoint runs
Then the backup script executes without directory errors
Given the database container starts
When migrations run
Then the strains table is successfully created before any alters
Given the need to verify these fixes
When QA verification is performed
Then the environment must fully initialize and pass all local health and integration checks
